title: Skedify
description: Linktree-style profile builder with a built-in booking system and payment integration. Clients book appointments directly from your profile — no registration needed.
longDescription: Skedify is a fullstack SaaS that lets creators and freelancers build a public profile with a list of services, links, and an availability calendar. Clients can book appointments directly from the profile without signing up. The platform supports a paid PRO plan (Stripe subscriptions), transactional email notifications (Resend), avatar uploads via Cloudinary, and authentication with Clerk. The backend is built with Java 21 and Spring Boot 4, with a Next.js 15 frontend and a React Native mobile app built with Expo.

title: Management App
description: Microservice-based task management backend with boards, subtasks, permissions, and a full activity audit trail. Communication between services via gRPC.
longDescription: A REST API backend built on a microservice architecture for managing tasks (todos) with subtasks, priorities, tags, and categories. Supports boards with sections, a sharing system with permission levels (viewer/editor/admin), and a full activity audit trail for every change. Inter-service communication is handled via gRPC, with JWT-based authorization throughout. Documented with Swagger/OpenAPI. The frontend (React + Three.js 3D visualization) is planned as the next phase — the goal is a Miro-like 3D board where notes live in a globe-shaped space.

title: Mindmap 3D
description: Interactive 3D note visualization on a globe — drag, connect, and explore relationships between ideas in spatial space. Frontend planned for Management App.
longDescription: A web app inspired by Miro, where notes (tiles) are displayed in a 3D space shaped like a globe. Users can drag notes, create connections between them, and visualize relationships spatially. Built on top of the Management App API (Spring Boot + JWT), the frontend uses React Three Fiber and Three.js for the 3D scene, with drag-and-drop interactions and real-time link rendering. This is the planned next phase of the management-application project.

title: Developer Portfolio
description: Personal portfolio built from scratch with Next.js 16 App Router, featuring WebGL shader backgrounds, scroll-driven CSS animations, View Transitions API, full i18n (pl/en), PWA with offline support, and 95+ Lighthouse scores across all categories.
longDescription: A showcase of modern web engineering — this portfolio uses plain Three.js for a fluid noise shader background (no React Three Fiber to keep the bundle lean), CSS scroll-driven animations with @supports fallbacks, and the View Transitions API for smooth page morphing. Built as a PWA with three-tier caching strategy. CI/CD via GitHub Actions with automated Lighthouse audits on every PR.
